xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: Notes to the unaudited consolidated financials results: 1. The above unaudited consolidated financial results for the for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 of Keystone Realtors Limited (''the Company'') and its subsidiaries (collectively ''the Group'') and its associates, joint ventures and jointly controlled operations, were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Holding Company at their respective meeting held on November 04, 2026. 2. The above results has been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Ind AS 34 ‘Interim Financial Reporting’, prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, as amended, read with relevant rules thereunder and in terms of Regulation 33 and Regulation 52 read with Regulation 63(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, as amended. 3. The Group operates in a single business segment, namely 'Real Estate and allied activities'. The Group's Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM) reviews the operating performance on an overall basis and, accordingly, as per Ind AS 108 (Operating Segments), the entire business constitutes a single operating segment. Further, the Group is carrying out its operations in India, hence geographical segment is not applicable. 4. During the six months period ended on September 30, 2026, the Holding Company has allotted 86,801 equity shares having a face value of Rs.10 each upon exercise of options granted under the Rustomjee Employee Stock Option Plan. 5. The Non-Convertible Debentures issued by the Holding Company are fully secured and are listed on BSE Limited. The additional disclosure on key ratios and financial indicators have been included in these financial results. For the formula used for calculation of ratios and financial indicators, please refer scan copies of the results filed with Stock Exchange. For Cash flow number also refer scan copy of the results filed with Stock Exchange because due to non-availability of specific heads we have entered amount in other items.
